name: Ill-Gotten Relics
description: This model can use one of the following relics at any time during its activation.

name: •Effigy of War
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit was in range, it gains Relentless Charge this turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: •Shimmering Visage
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in RNG, it gains Dodge. Shimmering Visage lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: •Tome of Living Shade
description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 RNG on their ranged and arcane attacks. Tome of Living Shade lasts for one round.

name: •Wilting Horn
description: While within 10" of this model, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of this model, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Wilting Horn lasts for one round.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Reposition [3"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

name: Unsummonable
description: This model cannot be summoned.

name: Soul Ravager
description: When this model destroys an enemy model with an attack, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models and the destroyed model is removed from play.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Soul Shatter
description: Once per turn, when a non-soulless living enemy model advances and ends is movement or is placed within 4" of this model, this model can spend 1 essence point. When it does the living model gains Soulless for the rest of the game and this model's Leader gains its soul token.

name: Hollow Ward
description: While within 4" of this model, friendly horrors gain +2 ARM against melee attack damage rolls made by construct, soulless, or undead models.

name: Unsummonable
description: This model cannot be summoned.

name: Soul Claiming
description: When a living non-soulless enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Chain Attack: Grab & Smash
description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately make a head-butt or throw power attack against that model even if it charged that activation.

name: Command Attachment [Cultist]
description: This command attachment can be added to a Cultist unit.

name: Battle Wizard
description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: Gang
description: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.

name: Granted: Self-Sacrifice
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Self-Sacrifice. (If a model with Self-Sacrifice is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in its unit within 3" of the model with Self-Sacrifice to be destroyed and the model with Self-Sacrifice removes 1 damage point.)

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Annihilation (★Attack)
description: Annihilation is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 10/10 arcane attack. Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Soul Taker: Requiem
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Knowledge of the Damned
description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

name: •Spectral Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: •Strength of Death
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Snacking
description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Chain Attack: Grab & Smash
description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately make a head-butt or throw power attack against that model even if it charged that activation.

description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: •Hex Bolt (★Attack)
description: Hex Bolt is a RNG 6, POW 13 arcane attack. Models hit cannot make special actions, special attacks, or power attacks for one round.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Convection
description: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

name: Energizer
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hellwrought
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Feign Death
description: This model cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.

name: Journeyman Warcaster
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Invictus]
description: The only warjack that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Invictus.

name: Cumbersome
description: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.

name: Powerful Attack
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can spend 1 focus point or be forced to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.

name: Armor-Piercing (★Attack)
description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Companion [Magnus, the Unstoppable]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Magnus, the Unstoppable. If Magnus is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Magnus’ battlegroup.

name: Aggressive
description: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.

name: Retaliatory Strike
description: If this model is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. This model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.

name: Arcing Fire
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Sustained Attack
description: During this model’s activation, when it makes an attack with this weapon against the last model hit by the weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

name: Thresher (★Attack)
description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

name: Bloodthirst
description: When it charges a living or undead model, this model gains +2" SPD.

name: Cleave
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.

name: Vengeance
description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Brutal Charge
description: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Deceleration
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

name: Hellfire
description: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: Influence
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Master Infernalist
description: This model is not an infernal master or Leader but has all the rules of an infernal master except it does not have a feat and cannot summon horrors. This model can have only light or lesser horrors in its battlegroup and must start with one in it's battlegroup at the begining of the game. This model replenishes its essence without sacrificing a model during its Control Phase.

name: Poison
description: Gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against living models.

name: Sacral Blade
description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending essence points.

name: Psycho Static
description: Spells channeled through this model the turn it is summoned suffer –3 RNG.

name: Channeling
description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller can channel spells through it

name: Dodge
description: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.

name: Soul Parasites
description: Living non-soulless enemy models and enemy models with Soul Vessel suffer –2 to their attack rolls while within 4" of this model.

name: Critical Paralysis
description: On a critical hit, a living model hit has its base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Wailing
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells.

name: Admonisher
description: When an enemy model is directly hit by an attack with this weapon, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of the model hit suffer an unboostable POW 10 magical damage roll. These damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Admonisher simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Convergence, Crucible Guard, Cryx, Cygnar, Grymkin, Khador, Legion, Protectorate, Retribution, Skorne, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Convergence, Crucible Guard, Cryx, Cygnar, Grymkin, Khador, Legion, Protectorate, Retribution, Skorne, and Trollbloods.

name: Ancient Shroud
description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

name: Dark Prophecy
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy models within 8" lose their essence points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, or be forced for one round.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Grip of Shadows (★Action)
description: This model gains Telemetry for one round. (Other friendly models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.)

name: •Whispers at the Gate (★Action)
description: Remove 1 essence point from each enemy infernal model currently within 5" of this model. Add 1 essence point to each friendly infernal model currently within 5" of this model.

name: •Word of Ruin (★Action)
description: This model gains Master of Ruin for one round. (Other models suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Defensive Strike
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Ghostly
description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

name: Shadow Guardian
description: You can choose not to deploy this model at the start of the game. If it is not deployed normally, you can put it into play when a friendly non-Umbral Faction model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack. Place this model completely within 3" of the hit model. This model is automatically hit by the ranged attack instead and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Zaateroth, The Weaver of Shadows
featDescription: While in Zaateroth’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. When an enemy model misses a friendly Faction model in Zaateroth’s control range with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place the friendly model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Whispering Void lasts for one round.

name: Black Spot
description: Target enemy warrior model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a friendly Faction model destroys one or more affected models with a basic melee or ranged attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one additional melee or ranged attack. Attacks gained from Black Spot cannot generate additional attacks from Black Spot.

name: Ghost Walk
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Rites of Torment
description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3". A horror can advance only once per turn as a result of Rites of Torment.

name: Stygian Abyss
description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Carnivore
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack rolls. When an affected model destroys a living or undead model with a melee attack, the destroyed model is removed from play and the spellcaster can remove d3 damage points.

name: Dark Legacy
description: When a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –3 RNG.

name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

name: Veneficium
description: When a spell or special rule on an enemy model causes one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, the enemy model suffers d3 damage points for each of this model’s upkeep spells that expire. Roll a separate d3 for each spell.

name: Black Mark
description: When this model destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with an attack with this weapon, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

name: Soul Chambered [1]
description: This model can spend 1 essence point or soul token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Critical Dispel
description: On a critical hit, upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.

name: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
featDescription: When an enemy model casts a spell while in Agathon’s control range, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while in Agathon’s control range, models gain one additional die on their arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. You choose a die to discard in each roll. Well of Sorrow lasts for one round.

name: Censure
description: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

name: Curse of Shadows
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

name: Hellmouth
description: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

name: Teleport
description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

name: Tether
description: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

name: Hellfire
description: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: Occultation
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

name: Revelations of the Outer Darkness

name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

name: True Sight
description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

name: Field Marshal [Sacred Ward]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Dark Banishment
description: When this model hits an enemy model with this weapon during its activation, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within d6 + 3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Dark Banishment only once per turn.

name: Puncture
description: On a direct hit, all models hit suffer d3 damage points.

name: Vorgoroth, Conduit of the Abyss
featDescription: Summon a horror without spending essence. Malignant Conduit does not count towards the maximum number of horrors this model can summon per activation or game. The horror summoned by Malignant Conduit must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat action the turn it is summoned.

name: Jackhammer
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

name: Mobility

name: Soulfire
description: When a living, non-soulless enemy model is boxed by Soulfire, the spellcaster gains 1 focus, fury, or essence point and the boxed model is removed from play. If the spellcaster does not have a special rule that allows it to gain focus, fury, or essence points, it cannot gain a focus, fury, or essence point as a result of Soulfire.

name: Expendable Creation
description: Target non-huge based horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending essence. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected horror suffers D3 damage points.

name: Psycho Surgery
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. name: Sucker!

description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

description: When an infernal master summons a horror and chooses this model to remove from play, the infernal master does not need to spend any essence points to summon the horror.

name: •Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack)
description: This model must be in its Leader’s control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader’s card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is an arcane attack.

name: Entropic Force
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Fly’s Kiss (★Attack)
description: Fly's Kiss is a RNG 8, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack boxes an enemy model, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

name: •Invocation of Bitterest Night (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth and Black Mantle for one round. (While B2B with a model with Black Mantle, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.)

name: •Dark Calling (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly horror. If the horror is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Dark Calling special action only once per turn.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Gang
description: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Rituals of Shadow (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly horror. If the horror was in range, it gains 1 essence point.

name: •Touch of Darkness (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly living soulless model. If that model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Acrobatics
description: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Run & Gun
description: At the end of its activation, if this model destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, it can make a full advance.

name: Devour Soul
description: When this model destroys a living enemy model with this weapon and generates a soul token, you can choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model’s soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from models destroyed by this weapon.

name: Luck
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Luck.

name: Insidious Plans
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: •Curse [Horror]
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit. If the target enemy model/unit is in range, friendly horrors gain +2 to attack rolls against it. Curse lasts for one turn.

name: •Shadow
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model. If the target enemy model is in range, when it advances or is placed, after its movement or placement is resolved one friendly non-trooper warrior model within 10" of this model can make a full advance. Shadow lasts for one round.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Arcane Pulse
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy upkeep spells on models within 8" of it expire.

name: Dark Power
description: This model gains an additional die on arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Gate Walker
description: Once per activation, immediately after this model casts a spell, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Hex Blast (★ Attack)
description: Hex Blast is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/8 arcane attack. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

name: •Marionette (★Attack)
description: Marionette is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Target enemy model/unit. You can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Marionette expires. Marionette lasts for one round.

name: •Puppet Master (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, you can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Puppet Master expires. Puppet Master lasts for one round.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Omodamos, The Black Gate
featDescription: Omodamos immediately casts Locked Horns without spending essence. Additionally, Omodamos and friendly Faction models activating in his control range gain +2 SPD and Ghostly. Shadows of Annihilation lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Breath of Corruption
description: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Flashing Blade
description: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon’s melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

name: Locked Horns
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Locked Horns lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Synergy
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: Hellhounds
description: When a Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, while the Cohort model is within 12" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Quagmire
description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

name: Batten Down the Hatches
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

name: Torment
description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

name: Lesser Warlock
description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Limited Battlegroup [War Boar MMD47]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is War Boar MMD47.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Critical Pitch
description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Companion [Carver Ultimus]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Carver Ultimus. If Carver is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Carver’s battlegroup.

name: Recoil
description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Full Boar
description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Exhaust Fumes
description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Forced Reload [1]
description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Anathema
description: When this model is summoned, center a cloud effect template on it. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round.  A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the template suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Withering Humor
description: On a direct hit, living and undead models hit by this attack suffer –2 ARM and lose Tough for one turn unless they can ignore gas effects.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Fire Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.
